tokens.name: page-bg
tokens.usage: Page ground, as rendered behind the page's content. Every text pairing below is checked against it.

tokens.name: page-text
tokens.usage: Default body text on `page-bg`: the colour most of the page's text uses that reads on it (7.3:1).

tokens.name: page-surface
tokens.usage: Surface most of the page's running text sits on (cards, panels).

tokens.name: statement-white
tokens.usage: Clean slate, clarity, truth. Used as background on `body`.

tokens.name: pure-white
tokens.usage: Used as background on `.nav-link:hover`, `.category-tag`; border on `.footer-bottom`, `.category-tag`; text on `.category-tag`. 1.0:1 on `page-bg` — under 3:1 here, as in the source: use it only on the lighter or darker fills the reference page pairs it with, never as text on `page-bg`.

tokens.name: off-white
tokens.usage: Used as background on `.data-table thead`, `.data-table tbody tr:hover`, `.btn-tertiary:hover`.

tokens.name: advocacy-blue
tokens.usage: Trust, stability, policy depth. Used as background on `.header`, `.btn-secondary`, `.badge-passed`.

tokens.name: action-red
tokens.usage: Urgency, passion, call to action. Used as background on `.logo-badge`, `.nav-link.active`, `.btn-primary`.

tokens.name: progress-green
tokens.usage: Success, growth, forward movement. Used as background on `.badge-active`.

tokens.name: alert-amber
tokens.usage: Attention, caution, awareness. Used as background on `.badge-monitoring`.

tokens.name: charcoal-text
tokens.usage: Authority, readability, weight. Used as text on `body`, `.table-title`, `.data-table th`; background on `.footer`. 14.1:1 on `page-bg`.

tokens.name: neutral-slate
tokens.usage: Professional, serious, grounded. Used as text on `.card-description`, `.data-table td`, `.btn-tertiary`. 7.3:1 on `page-bg`.

tokens.name: slate-lighter
tokens.usage: Used as text on `.footer`, `.footer-links a`. 1.4:1 on `page-bg` — under 3:1 here, as in the source: use it only on the lighter or darker fills the reference page pairs it with, never as text on `page-bg`.
